words.gloss: according to the path of justice

literal: In the country of the king who wields the sceptre according to justice, rain and harvest will gather together.
translation: In the land of a king who wields his sceptre in accordance with justice, both timely rain and abundant harvests will always come together.
modern: நீதிநெறிப்படி செங்கோல் செலுத்தும் அரசனுடைய நாட்டில், மழையும் விளைச்சலும் ஒருங்கே கூடி நிலைபெறும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the direct connection between a ruler's just governance and the prosperity of the natural world. The term 'இயல்புளி' means 'according to the established path of justice', and 'கோலோச்சும்' refers to wielding the sceptre of authority. In the country ('நாட்ட') of such a righteous king, both rain ('பெயலும்') and agricultural yield ('விளையுளும்') will gather together ('தொக்கு') in abundance. The poet suggests that nature itself responds harmoniously to a just administration, ensuring that the land never suffers from drought or famine.
